_templateNotes: Copy this file to a new label file such as squat_001.json, then edit the paths, split, expectedReps, and reps.
Use issueIds from availableIssues. Use an empty issueIds array for a clean rep.
Files named _template.json or *.template.json are ignored by dataset:evaluate and dataset:optimize.

reps.notes: Clean rep or describe the visible form issue.

notes: Draft label template. Copy to a real label file, review timings/issues, then set reviewStatus to reviewed.

availableIssues.feedbackMessage: Squat deeper — aim to get your thighs parallel.
Stand all the way up — fully extend your knees.
Incomplete rep — use a full range of motion.
Keep your heels planted — drive through your mid-foot.
Too much forward lean — keep your chest up.
Stay more upright — brace your core.
Control the ascent — don't bounce out of the hole.
Slow the descent — control the weight down.
